CREATE VIEW [dbo].[FACT_MDM_XSR_COMPONENTS_PERNR_V] AS 

SELECT 
CAST(1 AS INT) SERIES_ID
,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
, COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,

 Z.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT],
      [DATEKEY],
     CAST( NULL AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID],
	   XSR_PERNR,
	   [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR],
	    [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT],
      [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT],
	    [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT],
	    [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT],
	  [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],
	    [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT],
	   [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT],
        [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT],
        [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],
   XSR_COMPONENT_ID 
   FROM
(
select [FISCAL_PERIOD_INT],
      [DATEKEY],
     -- [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID],
	   PERNR_NUM AS XSR_PERNR,
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR],
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT],
       CASE WHEN MAX( [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT],
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT],
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT],
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT],
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT],
       CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT],
       CASE WHEN MAX( [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT])>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],

	   NRDP_DM.dbo.BinaryToInteger(REVERSE(CASE WHEN MAX( [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
       CASE WHEN MAX( [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
	   CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
       CASE WHEN MAX( [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END +
       CASE WHEN MAX( [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT])>0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ))  XSR_COMPONENT_ID 



	  FROM 
(SELECT [FISCAL_PERIOD_INT],
      [DATEKEY],
      [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID],
	  PERNR_NUM,
CAST(1 AS INT) AS [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT],
CAST(1 AS INT) AS  [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT]
  FROM [NRDP_DM].[dbo].[FACT_DEVICE_ACTIVATION]
  where [PERNR_NUM] > 0
  and [FLEX_ACTIVATION] > 0 
union all

SELECT [FISCAL_PERIOD_INT],
      [DATEKEY],
      [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID],
	  PERNR_NUM,
CAST(1 AS INT) AS [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR],
[XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT] AS [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT],
[ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT],
[ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT],
[ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],
[XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT],
[ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT],
[ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT]
from [dbo].[FACT_XSR_ALL]
  where [PERNR_NUM] > 0
UNION ALL 

SELECT [FISCAL_PERIOD_INT],
      [DATEKEY],
      [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID],
	  PERNR_NUM,
CAST(1 AS INT) AS [ANY_XSR_NUMERATOR],
CAST(1 AS INT) AS [TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [FLEX_DEVICE_ACTIVATION_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT],
CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT],
CAST(1 AS INT) AS [XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT]
from dbo.FACT_XM_LINE_DETAIL
  where [PERNR_NUM] > 0

  ) X

  group by [FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
      ,[DATEKEY]
      ,PERNR_NUM-- [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID]
	  ) Z LEFT JOIN 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP]	   agt WITH (NOLOCK)
on Z.XSR_PERNR = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND Z.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[DIM_MDM_AGENT_PERSON_DETAILS_V]
AS
SELECT 
[PERNR_NUM]
      ,nullif([FULL_NAME],'') AS [FULL_NAME]
      ,nullif([LAST_NAME],'') AS [LAST_NAME]
      ,nullif([FIRST_NAME],'') AS [FIRST_NAME]
      ,nullif([MIDDLE_NAME],'') AS [MIDDLE_NAME]
      ,nullif([NTLOGIN_ID],'') AS [NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,case when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Business Partner' then 'Vendor' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Contractor'  then 'Vendor' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Unknown Agent' then 'zUnknown'
		 else  [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] end as [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE]
      ,case when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Business Partner' then 'Partner' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Contractor'  then 'Partner' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Employee'  then 'Internal' 
		 else  [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] end as [AGENT_EMPLOYMENT_TYPE]
      ,[EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] AS [EMPLOYMENT_SUB_TYPE]
       ,case when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Business Partner' then 'Vendor' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Contractor'  then 'Vendor' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Employee'  then 'Employee' 
		 else  'Unknown' end as [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_HIER]
      ,case when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Business Partner' then 'Partner' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Contractor'  then 'Partner' 
		 when [EMPLOYMENT_TYPE] = 'Employee'  then 'Internal' 
		 else  null end as [AGENT_EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_HIER]
      ,nullif([EMPLOYMENT_TYPE],'Unknown Agent') AS [EMPLOYMENT_SUB_TYPE_HIER]

      ,nullif([EMAIL],'') AS [EMAIL]
      ,[HIRE_DATE]
      ,[TERMINATION_DATE]
FROM [dbo].[DIM_TABULAR_PERSON_DETAILS] WITH (NOLOCK)

WHEN A.X2_PILLAR IN ('West Division (Payment Services)','Central Division (Collections)','Credit, Collections, Fraud') THEN 'Finance'
WHEN A.X2_PILLAR = 'Specialty' AND A.X2_LOB='XUMO' THEN 'Non-Care' 
WHEN A.X2_PILLAR IN('Repair','Account Management','Specialty') THEN 'Care'
WHEN A.X2_PILLAR IN('Technical Support Center','Misc. Group') THEN 'Non-Care'
WHEN A.X2_PILLAR = 'Sales' THEN 'Sales'
WHEN A.X2_PILLAR IN('Comcast Business','Enterprise Business','Enterprise Business (Built under Comcast Business)') THEN 'CB Care'
WHEN QUEUE_NAME IN ('Comm Ops','Technical Operations')  THEN 'Non-Care'
WHEN QUEUE_NAME IN ('Call Center Sales','Direct Sales','Indirect Sales','Retail','Xfinity Communities')  THEN 'Sales'
WHEN QUEUE_NAME IN('CB Billing','CB Business Care','CB Collections','CB Repair','CB Retention') THEN 'CB Care'
WHEN QUEUE_NAME IN('CB Admin','CB Technical Operations','CB Admin','CB Finance & Accounting','CB Product Support','CB Technical Operations','CB Other') THEN 'CB Non-Care'
WHEN QUEUE_NAME IN('CB Xfinity Communities','CB Marketing','CB Sales & Marketing') THEN 'CB Sales'
ELSE 'Other' END
ELSE 'Other'
END AS QUEUE_GROUP


,CASE  WHEN QUEUE_NAME LIKE 'CB%' THEN 'Business' ELSE 'Residential' END AS QUEUE_BUSINESS
      ,[EWFM_JOB_TYPE]
      ,[JOB_CODE]
      ,[JOB_TITLE]
      ,[JOB_DESCRIPTION]
      ,[JOB_LEVEL]
,CASE WHEN [JOB_LEVEL] IN ('Director 1',
	'Director 2',
	'Director 3',
	'Manager 1',
	'Manager 2',
	'Supervisor',
	'Vice President 1',
	'Vice President 2',
	'Vice President 3',
	'Vice President 4',
	'BP Supervisor',
	'BP Manager',
	'BP Director') then 'Leader' else 'Non-Leader' end AS [LEADER_ROLE]
      ,[STAFFING_GROUP_NAME]
      ,[NED_STAFF_GROUP_NAME]
       ,-1 [AGENT_LOCATION_HIER_ID]
      ,coalesce(nullif(nullif(TRIM([DIVISION_NAME]),'Not Avaible'),'z Unknown Division'),'Not Available') as DIVISION_NAME

     ,[CALL_CENTER_NAME]
      ,[COMPANY_NAME]
      ,[LOCATION_NAME]
      ,[GEO_SHORE]
      ,[GEO_REGION]
      ,[GEO_COUNTRY]
      ,[HR_ORG_UNIT]
      ,[NAT_TEAM]
      ,[NAT_CALLCENTER]
      ,[NAT_DEPARTMENT]
      ,[NAT_SITE]

	  ,IS_NEW_HIRE
	  ,ISNA_FLAG

			WHEN JOB_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%MANAGER%' OR JOB_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%MGR%' THEN 'M'
			WHEN JOB_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%SUPERVISOR%' THEN 'S'
			WHEN JOB_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%ANALYST%' THEN 'A'
			WHEN JOB_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%DIRECTOR%' OR JOB_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'DIR %' THEN 'D'
			ELSE 'O'
		END AS ROLE_CD 
	 --- DMRASSIST- 4988 (Below 5 X2 Columns) on 17/11/2023
	,CASE WHEN A.X2_EWFM_JOB_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'zUnknown X2 EWFM JOB TYPE' ELSE A.X2_EWFM_JOB_TYPE END AS X2_EWFM_JOB_TYPE
	,CASE WHEN A.X2_PILLAR IS NULL THEN 'zUnknown PILLAR' ELSE A.X2_PILLAR END AS X2_PILLAR
	,CASE WHEN A.X2_QUEUE_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Other' ELSE A.X2_QUEUE_NAME END AS X2_QUEUE_NAME
	,CASE WHEN A.X2_SUB_QUEUE_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Other Sub Queue' ELSE A.X2_SUB_QUEUE_NAME END AS X2_SUB_QUEUE_NAME
	,CASE WHEN A.X2_EWFM_LOB IS NULL THEN 'zUnknown LOB' ELSE A.X2_EWFM_LOB END AS X2_EWFM_LOB
	--DMRCXSO-2444
	,A.X2_Company
	,A.X2_Division
	,A.X2_LOB
	,A.X2_Language
	,A.X2_AGENT_TYPE
	,A.X2_SITE
	,A.X2_TRAINING_STATUS
	,A.X2_SUB_QUEUE_DETAIL
	  from [dbo].[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION] A
	  LEFT JOIN DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_FLAGS B
ON A.AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID = B.AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID
--DMRCXSO-1530
LEFT JOIN (
				SELECT AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID, FISCAL_PERIOD_INT FROM (
				SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID ORDER BY FISCAL_PERIOD_INT DESC) AS RN,
				AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID, FISCAL_PERIOD_INT FROM DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP
					)A
				WHERE RN=1 ) C
				ON A.AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID = C.AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT -1 [AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID]
      ,-1 [AGENT_SKILL_HIER_ID]
      ,'Other Agent Skill' as [AGENT_SKILL]
      ,'Other' [SUB_QUEUE_NAME]
      ,'Other' [QUEUE_NAME]
      ,'Other' [QUEUE_GROUP]
      ,'Residential' [QUEUE_BUSINESS]
      ,'z No EWFM Job Type' [EWFM_JOB_TYPE]
	  ,'z Unknown Job Code' [JOB_CODE]
	  ,'z Unknown Job Title' [JOB_TITLE]
	  ,'Non-Leader'  [LEADER_ROLE]
	  ,'z Unknown Job Description'	[JOB_DESCRIPTION]
	  ,'z Unknown Job Level' [JOB_LEVEL]
	  ,'z Unknown Staffing Group Name' [STAFFING_GROUP_NAME]
	  ,'z Unknown NED Staff Group' [NED_STAFF_GROUP_NAME]

      ,-1 [AGENT_LOCATION_HIER_ID]
      ,'Not Available'[DIVISION_NAME]
      ,'Not Available'[REGION_NAME]
      ,'Unknown' [COMPANY_NAME]
      ,'zUnknown' [CALL_CENTER_NAME]
      ,'Unknown' [LOCATION_NAME]
	  ,'Unknown' [GEO_SHORE]
      ,'Unknown' [GEO_REGION]
      ,'Unknown' [GEO_COUNTRY]
      ,'Unknown' [HR_ORG_UNIT]
	,'zUnknown National Team' AS NAT_TEAM
	,'zUnknown National CallCenter' AS NAT_CALLCENTER
	,'zUnknown National Department' AS NAT_DEPARTMENT
	,'zUnknown National Site' AS NAT_SITE
	  ,'Unknown Agent' as KNOWN_AGENT_IND 
,-1 as CA_LEVEL_CD
	  ,'Not Available' as [IS_NEW_HIRE]
	  ,'Not Available' as [ISNA_FLAG]
	  ,'O' as [Role_CD] 
	 --- DMRASSIST- 4988 (Below 5 X2 Columns) on 15/11/2023 
	  ,'zUnknown X2 EWFM JOB TYPE' X2_EWFM_JOB_TYPE 
	  ,'zUnknown PILLAR' X2_PILLAR 
	  ,'Other' X2_QUEUE_NAME 
	  ,'Other Sub Queue' X2_SUB_QUEUE_NAME 
	  ,'zUnknown LOB' X2_EWFM_LOB
	  --DMRCXSO-2444
	,'zUnknown Company' as X2_Company
	,'zUnknown Division' as X2_Division
	,'zUnknown LOB' as X2_LOB
	,'zUnknown Language' as X2_Language
	,'zUnknown AGENT_TYPE' as X2_AGENT_TYPE
	,'zUnknown Site' as X2_SITE
	,'zUnknown TRAINING_STATUS' as X2_TRAINING_STATUS
	,'zUnknown SUB_QUEUE_DETAIL' as X2_SUB_QUEUE_DETAIL
  FROM DIM_DATE 
  WHERE CALENDAR_DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[DIM_MDM_AGENT_SUPERVISOR_V] AS

      , [PERNR_NUM]
      ,[NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,nullif([FULL_NAME],'') as [FULL_NAME]
      ,[LAST_NAME]
      ,[FIRST_NAME]

      ,[VP2_PERNR_NUM]
      ,[VP3_PERNR_NUM]

      ,[MGR2_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[DIR1_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[DIR2_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[DIR3_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[VP1_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[VP2_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[VP3_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[SVP_NTLOGIN_ID]
      ,[SUPV_NAME]
      ,[MGR1_NAME]
      ,[MGR2_NAME]
      ,[DIR1_NAME]
      ,[DIR2_NAME]
      ,[DIR3_NAME]
      ,[VP1_NAME]
      ,[VP2_NAME]

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[DIM_MDM_AGENT_TENURE_V] AS 
SELECT [AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID]
       ,CAST(-1 AS MONEY) AS [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID]
      ,[INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC]
	  ,CASE [INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC] 
		WHEN '200 Interactions or more' THEN 2 
		WHEN 'Between 150 and 199 Interactions' THEN 4
		WHEN 'Between 100 and 149 Interactions' THEN 6
		WHEN 'Between 50 and 99 Interactions' THEN 8
		WHEN 'Between 10 and 49 Interactions' THEN 10 
		WHEN 'Between 1 and 9 Interactions' THEN 12 
		ELSE 14 END AS [INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_ORDER]
	  ,CASE [INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC] 
		WHEN '200 Interactions or more' THEN  '100 Interactions or more'
		WHEN 'Between 150 and 199 Interactions' THEN '100 Interactions or more'
		WHEN 'Between 100 and 149 Interactions' THEN '100 Interactions or more'
		WHEN 'Between 50 and 99 Interactions' THEN 'Less then 100 Interactions'
		WHEN 'Between 10 and 49 Interactions' THEN 'Less then 100 Interactions'
		WHEN 'Between 1 and 9 Interactions' THEN 'Less then 100 Interactions'
		ELSE 'Less then 100 Interactions' END AS [SHORT_INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC]

      ,case when [INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC]= 'Between 1 and 9 Interactions' 	then 'Less than 10 calls'
	     when [INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC]= 'No Interactions' 	then 'Less than 10 calls'
		 else replace([INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC],'Interactions','Calls') end [CALLS_CHATS_PER_PERIOD_DESC]
	  ,CASE [INTERACTION_PER_PERIOD_DESC] 
		WHEN '200 Interactions or more' THEN 2 
		WHEN 'Between 150 and 199 Interactions' THEN 4
		WHEN 'Between 100 and 149 Interactions' THEN 6
		WHEN 'Between 50 and 99 Interactions' THEN 8
		WHEN 'Between 10 and 49 Interactions' THEN 10 
		WHEN 'Between 1 and 9 Interactions' THEN 14 
		ELSE 14 END AS [CALLS_CHATS_PER_PERIOD_ORDER]

      ,[CALLS_PER_PERIOD_DESC]
      ,[CHATS_PER_PERIOD_DESC]
      ,[AGENT_INTERACTION_MEDIUM_USAGE]
      ,CASE WHEN [AGENT_INTERACTION_MEDIUM_USAGE] LIKE 'VOICE%' THEN 'Calls'
         WHEN [AGENT_INTERACTION_MEDIUM_USAGE] LIKE 'C-%' THEN 'Chats'
         else 'Unknown' end AGENT_PRIMARY_INTERACTION_MEDIUM 
      ,[AGENT_TENURE_DESC]
	  ,CASE [AGENT_TENURE_DESC]
	    WHEN '0-6 Months' THEN 0
	    WHEN '6-12 Months' THEN 2
	    WHEN '1-2 Years' THEN 4
	    WHEN '2-3 Years' THEN 6
	    WHEN '3-5 Years' THEN 8
	    WHEN '5-10 Years' THEN 10
	    WHEN '10-15 Years' THEN 12 
	    WHEN '15-20 Years' THEN 14
	    WHEN '20+ Years' THEN 16
	    WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 18
	    ELSE 20 END [AGENT_TENURE_SORT_ID]
      ,[AGENT_SHORT_TENURE_DESC]
	  ,CASE [AGENT_SHORT_TENURE_DESC]
	    WHEN '0-30 Days' THEN 0
	    WHEN '31-60 Days' THEN 2
	    WHEN '61-90 Days' THEN 4
	    WHEN '91-120 Days' THEN 6
	    WHEN '121-180 Days' THEN 8
	    WHEN 'Over 180 Days' THEN 10
	    else  14
	    END [AGENT_SHORT_TENURE_SORT_ID]

      ,[AGENT_CALL_TENURE_DESC]
	  ,CASE [AGENT_CALL_TENURE_DESC]
	    WHEN '0-30 Days' THEN 0
	    WHEN '31-60 Days' THEN 2
	    WHEN '61-90 Days' THEN 4
	    WHEN '91-120 Days' THEN 6
	    WHEN '121-180 Days' THEN 8
	    WHEN 'Over 180 Days' THEN 10
	    WHEN 'No Calls Taken' THEN 12
	    WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 14
	    else  16
	    END [AGENT_CALL_TENURE_SORT_ID]
      ,[AGENT_CHAT_TENURE_DESC]
	  ,CASE [AGENT_CHAT_TENURE_DESC]
	    WHEN '0-30 Days' THEN 0
	    WHEN '31-60 Days' THEN 2
	    WHEN '61-90 Days' THEN 4
	    WHEN '91-120 Days' THEN 6
	    WHEN '121-180 Days' THEN 8
	    WHEN 'Over 180 Days' THEN 10
	    WHEN 'No Chats Taken' THEN 12
	    WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 14
	    else  16
	    END [AGENT_CHAT_TENURE_SORT_ID]

      ,[AGENT_INTERACTION_TENURE_DESC]
	  ,CASE [AGENT_INTERACTION_TENURE_DESC]
	    WHEN '0-30 Days' THEN 0
	    WHEN '31-60 Days' THEN 2
	    WHEN '61-90 Days' THEN 4
	    WHEN '91-120 Days' THEN 6
	    WHEN '121-180 Days' THEN 8
	    WHEN 'Over 180 Days' THEN 10
	    WHEN 'No Interactions Taken' THEN 12
	    WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 14
	    else  16
	    END [AGENT_INTERACTION_TENURE_SORT_ID]

	  ,case when  [AGENT_TENURE_DESC] in ('10-15 Years','15-20 Years','20+ Years') then '10+ Years'
       else COALESCE([AGENT_TENURE_DESC] ,'UNKNOWN') end as [AGENT_TENURE_GROUP]

	  ,CASE [AGENT_TENURE_DESC]
	    WHEN '0-6 Months' THEN 0
	    WHEN '6-12 Months' THEN 2
	    WHEN '1-2 Years' THEN 4
	    WHEN '2-3 Years' THEN 6
	    WHEN '3-5 Years' THEN 8
	    WHEN '5-10 Years' THEN 10
	    WHEN '10-15 Years' THEN 12 
	    WHEN '15-20 Years' THEN 12
	    WHEN '20+ Years' THEN 12
	    WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 18
	    ELSE 20 END [AGENT_TENURE_GROUP_SORT_ID]

      ,[REPORTING_FISCAL_WEEK_END_DATE]
      ,[CalendarYear]

      ,[CalendarYearMonth]
      ,[CalendarWeekSundayStart]
      ,[CAL_WEEK_END_SUN_DATE]

	  ,LASTCLOSED_14_MONTHS

    (

CREATE view  [dbo].[DIM_MDM_FISCAL_CALENDAR_V] AS SELECT cp.[DATEKEY]
      ,cp.[CALENDAR_DATE] 
      ,datePART(dw,cp.[CALENDAR_DATE]) DAY_OF_WEEK_ID
      ,datename(dw,cp.[CALENDAR_DATE]) DAY_OF_WEEK
      ,cp.[CALENDAR_DATE_DESC]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD_WEEK]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD_WEEK_DESC]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
      
         ,cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD]
         ,right(cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD],2)+'/21/'+left(cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD],4) FISCAL_PERIOD_FMT
      ,cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD_REVERSE_ORDER]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_QUARTER]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_QUARTER_DESC]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_QUARTER_REVERSE_ORDER]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_YEAR]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_YEAR_DESC]
      ,cp.[FISCAL_YEAR_REVERSE_ORDER]
      ,cp.MTD_KEY
      ,cp.[LCM_KEY]
      ,cp.[YTDLCM_KEY]
      ,case when cp.[YTD_KEY] is null then 60005000 else  cp.[YTD_KEY] end [YTD_KEY] 
      ,case when cp.[YTD_KEY] is null then 'Other Non YTD periods' else cp.[YTD_DESC] end [YTD_DESC] 
      ,cp.[CUST_PERIOD_KEY]
      ,case when cp.[CUST_PERIOD_DESC] like 'Current%' then 'Current Month to Date' 
	      when cp.[CUST_PERIOD_DESC] like 'Last%' then 'Last Closed Month'
		  else cp.[CUST_PERIOD_DESC] end as CUST_PERIOD_DESC
      ,cp.[CUST_PERIOD_ORDER]
   ,CASE WHEN cp.DATEKEY < 20200313 THEN 'Pre'
  when cp.Datekey > 20200411 then 'Post'
  else 'Transition' end as Agent_Shift_Times
         ,  max(cp.DATEKEY) over (partition by d.[WEEK_ENDING_FRIDAY_DATE]) AS WEEK_ENDING_FRIDAY_ID 
         , d.[WEEK_ENDING_FRIDAY_DATE]
         ,  max(cp.DATEKEY) over (partition by cp.CAL_WEEK_END_SAT_DATE) AS WEEK_ENDING_SATURDAY_ID 
   , cp.CAL_WEEK_END_SAT_DATE
         --, case when [FISCAL_PERIOD_WEEK_DESC] is not null then 
                     --  cast(d.REPORTWEEK_END as varchar(10))  
                     -- else null end as REPORTING_WEEK_DESC
         , max(cp.DATEKEY) over (partition by D.[REPORTING_FISCAL_WEEK_END_DATE]) AS REPORTING_FISCAL_WEEK_END_DATE_ID
         ,D.[REPORTING_FISCAL_WEEK_END_DATE]
         ,NULL AS [MAX_NBX_PERIOD_KEY]
  ,datepart(mm,max(cp.[CALENDAR_DATE]) over (partition by cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT])) FISCAL_PERIOD_NAME_ID
  ,datename(mm,max(cp.[CALENDAR_DATE]) over (partition by cp.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT])) FISCAL_PERIOD_NAME
  ,CASE WHEN LD.DATEKEY IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
   WHEN CALENDAR_DATE_DESC  IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE null END CLOSED_IND 

  FROM [NRDP_DM].[dbo].[DIM_DATE_CUSTOM_PERIODS] cp left join 
 [dbo].[DIM_DATE_VENDOR_REPORTING]  d
  on cp.CALENDAR_DATE = d.CALENDAR_DATE LEFT JOIN
(SELECT datekey, CALENDAR_DATE, FISCAL_PERIOD_BEGIN_DATE FROM  [dbo].[DIM_DATE_LATEST_DAY_SNAPSHOT])  LD 
ON CP.datekey < LD.datekey
WHERE CP.FISCAL_YEAR>2018

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[DIM_MDM_FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_V] AS
 SELECT  a.CALENDAR_DATE, 

(FISCAL_YEAR*100+FISCAL_MNTH) FISCAL_PERIOD_INT,
CASE WHEN a.CALENDAR_DATE > l.Load_Yrago_date  and a.CALENDAR_DATE <= L.LOAD_YRAGO_END_PERIOD_DATE THEN (FISCAL_YEAR*100+FISCAL_MNTH)*-1 
  WHEN a.CALENDAR_DATE > l.Load_Prior_date  AND A.CALENDAR_DATE < L.LOAD_LAST_PERIOD_COMPLETE_DATE THEN (FISCAL_YEAR*100+FISCAL_MNTH)*-1
  ELSE (FISCAL_YEAR*100+FISCAL_MNTH) END AS FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT ,

CASE WHEN a.CALENDAR_DATE > l.Load_Yrago_date  and a.CALENDAR_DATE <= L.LOAD_YRAGO_END_PERIOD_DATE THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS YTD_IND ,
CASE WHEN a.CALENDAR_DATE > l.Load_Prior_date AND A.CALENDAR_DATE < L.LOAD_LAST_PERIOD_COMPLETE_DATE THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS PP_IND ,
L.LOAD_DATE,
CASE WHEN A.CALENDAR_DATE  > LCM_END_DATE THEN 'Current Month to Date' 
	WHEN CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN LCM_BEG_DATE AND LCM_END_DATE THEN 'Last Closed Month'
	else a.FISCAL_PERIOD end PERIOD_DESC,FISCAL_PERIOD_INT*-1 AS FISCAL_PERIOD_ORDER 
FROM  DIM_DATE  a  join  
(
SELECT [CALENDAR_DATE] AS LOAD_DATE,
DATEADD(MONTH,-1,CALENDAR_DATE) AS LOAD_PRIOR_DATE,
DATEADD(YEAR,-1,CALENDAR_DATE) AS LOAD_YRAGO_DATE,
DATEADD(YEAR,-1,FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE) AS LOAD_YRAGO_END_PERIOD_DATE,
DATEADD(DAY,-1,FISCAL_YEAR_BEGIN_DATE) AS LOAD_PRIOR_END_YEAR_DATE,
FISCAL_PERIOD_BEGIN_DATE AS LOAD_LAST_PERIOD_COMPLETE_DATE,
DATEADD(DAY,-29,[CALENDAR_DATE]) AS LTR_30_DATE,
DATEADD(DAY,-59,[CALENDAR_DATE]) AS LTR_60_DATE,
DATEADD(DAY,-89,[CALENDAR_DATE]) AS LTR_90_DATE,
LCM_BEG_DATE, LCM_END_DATE
FROM [dbo].[DIM_DATE_LATEST_DAY_SNAPSHOT]
) l 
on a.CALENDAR_DATE <=L.LOAD_DATE
where a.fiscal_year >=2019

SELECT CAST(1 AS INT) AS SERIES_ID, 
 c.CALENDAR_DATE
,C.DATEKEY
,C.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY % 100 AS CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY
, COALESCE(EBB.CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY,0) AS CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY -- Added by SS ON 7/19/21

,CAST(-1 AS INTEGER) CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_DEMO_KEY -- Added by SS ON 7/19/21
,CAST(-1 AS INTEGER) MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID

--,C.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID

,c.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
,COALESCE(D.[FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT],c.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]) AS [FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT]
,c.[PERNR_NUM]
,-1 AS BASE_RGU_PROFILE_ID
,c.[NRDP_CALL_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
,c.[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
,cast(-1 as integer) as [TRANSFER_ORIGIN_AGENT_ID]
,cast(-1 as integer) as [TRANSFER_ORIGIN_IACT_ID]
,c.[TENURE_ID]
,[ADJUST_SUBSCRIBER_CNT]
,[ADJUST_AMT]
,cast(8640100 as integer) as AGENT_INTERACTION_ORDER_ID
,COALESCE(c.SENTIMENT_QA_ID,100000) AS SENTIMENT_QA_ID
,COALESCE(c.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID,-1) AS NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID
,COALESCE(atr.AGENT_TRAINING_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TRAINING_ID
,COALESCe(xap.PRE_NRDP_XAP_EXIT_ID,-1) as PRE_NRDP_XAP_EXIT_ID
,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
, COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID
,coalesce(cdr.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID,0) as CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID

,coalesce(cdr.SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID,0) as SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID
,COALESCE(EBB.PRODCAT_EBB_ID,0) AS PRODCAT_EBB_ID

FROM   
  [NRDP_DM].[dbo].[FACT_ADJ] C left join 
  DIM_CURRENT_TODATE D 
  ON C.CALENDAR_DATE = D.CALENDAR_DATE  left join 
  FACT_CALL_DRIVER_SPEECH_QUERY_REF cdr

  AND C.CALENDAR_DATE = cdr.CALENDAR_DATE

  AND C.METRIC_SOURCE_KEY = cdr.METRIC_SOURCE_KEY
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[FACT_PRE_XAP_EXIT] xap

  and c.[METRIC_SOURCE] = xap.[METRIC_SOURCE]
  and  c.[CALENDAR_DATE] =xap.[CALENDAR_DATE]
  and c.[METRIC_SOURCE_KEY] = xap.[METRIC_SOURCE_KEY] left join 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt
on C.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND C.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT lEFT JOIN

  ON c.DATEKEY=atr.DATEKEY
  and c.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID= atr.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID

SELECT 	   A.DATEKEY
    , CAST(1 AS INT) AS [SERIES_ID]
      ,A.[PERNR_NUM]
	  ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
	  ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
	  ,COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID
	  	   	  ,A.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT
			  ,CAST(1 AS INT) AS [AGENT_DAY_COUNT]
  FROM dbo.FACT_IACT_MONTHLY_PERNR A WITH (NOLOCK)   left join 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt WITH (NOLOCK)
on A.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND A.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT

,CAST(-1 AS INTEGER) MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID

  ON F.CALENDAR_DATE = D.CALENDAR_DATE left join 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt
on f.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND F.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT

	  ,COALESCE(dv.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID,0) AS CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP3_ID,0) AS CALL_DRIVER_GROUP3_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP1_ID,0) AS SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP1_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID,0) AS SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID
	  ,coalesce(dv.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID,-1) as NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID
      ,COALESCE(dv.PRODCAT_EBB_ID,0) AS PRODCAT_EBB_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.PRE_NRDP_XAP_EXIT_ID,-1) as PRE_NRDP_XAP_EXIT_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID,-1) as MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID

	  ,COALESCE(atr.AGENT_TRAINING_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TRAINING_ID
	  ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
	  ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
	  , COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID
	  
	  ,NULLIF(c.[AICR_CUST_CONTACT_RECEIVED_CNT],0) AS [AICR_CUST_CONTACT_RECEIVED_CNT]

,NULLIF(c.[AICR_CUST_REPEAT_CALL_GROUP_IND],0) AS [AICR_CUST_REPEAT_CALL_GROUP_IND]
,NULLIF(c.[AICR_CUST_REPEAT_CONTACT_GROUP_IND],0) AS [AICR_CUST_REPEAT_CONTACT_GROUP_IND]
,NULLIF(c.[AICR_CUST_REPEAT_CHAT_GROUP_IND],0) AS [AICR_CUST_REPEAT_CHAT_GROUP_IND]

,NULLIF(c.[AICR_IQUEUE_REPEAT_CHAT_GROUP_IND],0) AS [AICR_IQUEUE_REPEAT_CHAT_GROUP_IND]
,NULLIF(c.[AICR_ITYP_REPEAT_CONTACT_GROUP_IND],0) AS [AICR_ITYP_REPEAT_CONTACT_GROUP_IND]

  FROM [NRDP_DM].[dbo].[FACT_AICR_60_90] C left join 
  DIM_CURRENT_TODATE D 
  ON C.CALENDAR_DATE = D.CALENDAR_DATE LEFT join
  LKP_DIM_VALUES_INTERACTIONS dv WITH (NOLOCK) 
  ON C.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT =  dv.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT 
  AND c.CALENDAR_DATE = dv.CALENDAR_DATE
  AND c.METRIC_SOURCE = dv.METRIC_SOURCE
  AND c.METRIC_SOURCE_KEY = dv.METRIC_SOURCE_KEY  left join 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt
on C.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND C.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT lEFT JOIN
  [dbo].[FACT_AGENT_TRAINING_REF_V] atr
  ON c.DATEKEY=atr.DATEKEY
  and c.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID= atr.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID
WHERE c.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT > 201812

SELECT c.DATEKEY
      ,c.[CALENDAR_DATE]
	  ,c.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
	  ,c.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT] AS FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT

      ,dv.[PERNR_NUM]
	  ,dv.[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY]

      ,dv.[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_DEMO_KEY]

      ,dv.[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]

      ,dv.[TENURE_ID]

	  ,dv.[NBX_M2M_ID]

	  ,CASE WHEN dv.PERNR_NUM > 0 AND dv.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LTR_CANDIDATE_IND
      ,COALESCE(c.[PRODCAT_XTV_DGTL_ID],0) AS [PRODCAT_XTV_DGTL_ID]
      ,COALESCE(c.[PRODCAT_XTV_PPAY_ID],0) AS [PRODCAT_XTV_PPAY_ID]

      ,COALESCE(c.[PRODCAT_AO_ID],0) AS [PRODCAT_AO_ID]
	  ,COALESCE(dv.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID,0) AS CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID,0) AS CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP3_ID,0) AS CALL_DRIVER_GROUP3_ID

	  ,COALESCE(dv.SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID,0) AS SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID
	  ,coalesce(dv.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID,-1) as NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID

	  ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
	  ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
	  , COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID
	  --,case when C.pernr_num < 0 then cast(0 as bit) else cast(1 as bit) END AS IS_VALID_PERNR


	  ,CASE WHEN c.PERNR_NUM > 0 AND dv.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID>0 THEN CP.[LTR_IND] ELSE 0 END LTR_IND 
,C.INTERACTION_OFFERED_COUNT - c.INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT AS CALLS_ABANDONED_FLAG_COUNT
,c.INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT AS CALLS_HANDLED_COUNT
,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)  AS CALLS_HANDLED_CONSULTS
,c.INTERACTION_OFFERED_COUNT AS   CALLS_OFFERED_COUNT
,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS [CALLS_TRANSFERRED_COUNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_CNT],0) as [CALLS_BEG_SUB_CNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_XM_RGU_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XM_RGU_CNT]

,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_INST_TV_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_INST_TV_CNT]

,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_XMPP_CNT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XMPP_CNT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_SUB_REV_AMT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_REV_AMT]
,NULLIF(c.[BEG_XM_RGU_REV_AMT] * c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT],0) as  [CALLS_BEG_SUB_XM_REV_AMT]
,nullif(( 5 - (coalesce(c.[BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT],0) + 
coalesce(c.[BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT],0) +
coalesce(c.[BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT],0) +
coalesce(c.[BEG_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT],0) +

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '20-30'THEN 17

	then c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT] else 0 end,0) as [CHATS_WITH_RGUS_CNT]

,NULLIF(CUST_CHAT_AGENT_NONRESPONSIVE,0) AS CUST_CHAT_AGENT_NONRESPONSIVE

,NULLIF(TOTAL_AGENT_FREEHAND_LINES_CNT,0) AS TOTAL_AGENT_FREEHAND_LINES_CNT
,NULLIF(TOTAL_AGENT_SCRIPT_LINES_CNT,0) AS TOTAL_AGENT_SCRIPT_LINES_CNT
,NULLIF(TOTAL_CUSTOMER_LINES_CNT,0) AS TOTAL_CUSTOMER_LINES_CNT
,NULLIF(CUSTOMER_LOST_CONNECT_CNT,0) AS CUSTOMER_LOST_CONNECT_CNT

,CASE WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '0' THEN 1

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '30+'THEN 6

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '10-20'THEN 10
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '20-30'THEN 11

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '0-5'THEN 14

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '20-30'THEN 17

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP IS NULL THEN 20

  and  c.[CALENDAR_DATE] =EBB.[CALENDAR_DATE]

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[FACT_MDM_EINSTEIN_ACTION_V] AS

	  ,COALESCE(D1.[FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT],C.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]) AS [FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT]

      ,C.[CALENDAR_DATE]
      ,c.DATEKEY
      ,C.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY  % 100 AS CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY
  ,COALESCE(EBB.CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY,0) AS CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY
    ,c.[PERNR_NUM]
     -- ,C.[NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID]
      ,C.[NRDP_CALL_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[BASE_RGU_PROFILE_ID]
      ,[TRANSFER_ORIGIN_AGENT_ID]
      ,[TRANSFER_ORIGIN_IACT_ID]
      ,[TENURE_ID]
      ,[NRDP_EINSTEIN_TROUBLESHOOT_ID]
      --,cast(null as nvarchar(12))  as [ACTION_VERSION]
      --,cast(null as nvarchar(10)) as [ACTION_ONLY]
      ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
      ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
      , COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID

      ,c.[TOTAL_NON_REQUIRED]
      ,c.[TOTAL_REQUIRED]
      ,c.[COMPLETED_NON_REQUIRED]
      ,c.[COMPLETED_REQUIRED]
      ,c.[TOTAL]
      ,c.[COMPLETED_TOTAL]
	  ,c.[INTERACTION_OFFERED_CNT]
	  ,c.[INTERACTION_HANDLED_CNT]
	  ,c.[E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT]
	  ,c.[E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT]
--Added by SS ON 6/17/21
	 , CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 12 THEN C.COMPLETED_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END AS COMPLETED_REQUIRED_SIK,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 11 THEN C.COMPLETED_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END AS COMPLETED_REQUIRED_SERVICE,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 14 THEN C.COMPLETED_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END AS COMPLETED_REQUIRED_PROVISIONING
,(CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 12 THEN C.COMPLETED_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 11 THEN C.COMPLETED_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END
+ CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 14 THEN C.COMPLETED_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_REQUIRED_REPAIR

,CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 12 THEN C.E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT_SIK,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 11 THEN C.E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT_SERVICE,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 14 THEN C.E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS E360_UNIQUE_COMPLETED_COUNT_PROVISIONING

,CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 12 THEN C.TOTAL_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_REQUIRED_SIK,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 11 THEN C.TOTAL_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_REQUIRED_SERVICE,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 14 THEN C.TOTAL_REQUIRED ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_REQUIRED_PROVISIONING

,CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 12 THEN C.E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT_SIK,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 11 THEN C.E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT_SERVICE,
CASE WHEN INTERACTION_QUEUE_ID = 14 THEN C.E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS E360_UNIQUE_INTERACTIONS_HANDLED_COUNT_PROVISIONING

,COALESCE(c.SENTIMENT_QA_ID,100000) AS SENTIMENT_QA_ID
,COALESCE(atr.AGENT_TRAINING_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TRAINING_ID
,coalesce(c.AGENT_INTERACTION_ORDER_ID,8640100) as AGENT_INTERACTION_ORDER_ID
,COALESCE(C.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID,-1) AS NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID
,coalesce(cdr.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID,0) as CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID
,coalesce(cdr.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID,0) as CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID
,coalesce(cdr.CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID,0) as CALL_DRIVER_GROUP3_ID
,coalesce(cdr.SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP1_ID,0) as SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP1_ID
,coalesce(cdr.SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID,0) as SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID
,COALESCE(EBB.PRODCAT_EBB_ID,0) AS PRODCAT_EBB_ID
,DATEADD(YEAR,1,C.CALENDAR_DATE) AS YRAGO_DATE
,DATEADD(M,1,C.CALENDAR_DATE) AS PRIOR_DATE
FROM   [NRDP_DM].[dbo].[FACT_EINSTEIN_ACTION] c left join 
  DIM_CURRENT_TODATE D1 
  ON C.CALENDAR_DATE = D1.CALENDAR_DATE  left join 
  FACT_CALL_DRIVER_SPEECH_QUERY_REF cdr
  ON C.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = cdr.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT
  AND C.CALENDAR_DATE = cdr.CALENDAR_DATE
  AND C.METRIC_SOURCE = cdr.METRIC_SOURCE
  AND C.METRIC_SOURCE_KEY = cdr.METRIC_SOURCE_KEY left join 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt
on C.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND C.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT lEFT JOIN
  [dbo].[FACT_AGENT_TRAINING_REF_V] atr
  ON c.DATEKEY=atr.DATEKEY
  and c.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID= atr.NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID
left join FACT_EBB_BULK_REF EBB with (nolock)
    on c.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT] = EBB.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
  and c.[METRIC_SOURCE] = EBB.[METRIC_SOURCE]
  and  c.[CALENDAR_DATE] =EBB.[CALENDAR_DATE]

  --Join Added by SS on 6/17/21
  LEFT JOIN DIM_TABULAR_CALL_ATTRIBUTE_V D

SELECT

C.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
      ,C.[METRIC_SOURCE]
      ,C.[CALENDAR_DATE]
      ,C.[METRIC_SOURCE_KEY]
      ,C.[DATEKEY]
      ,C.[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY]
      ,C.[PERNR_NUM]

      ,dv.[CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY]
      ,dv.[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_DEMO_KEY]
	  ,dv.[NRDP_CALL_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
	  ,coalesce(dv.[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID],-1) as [NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,dv.[TRANSFER_ORIGIN_AGENT_ID]
      ,dv.[TRANSFER_ORIGIN_IACT_ID]
      ,dv.[TENURE_ID]
      ,dv.[BASE_RGU_PROFILE_ID]
      ,COALESCE(dv.SENTIMENT_QA_ID,100000) AS SENTIMENT_QA_ID
	  ,dv.[NBX_M2M_ID]
	  ,CASE WHEN dv.PERNR_NUM > 0 AND dv.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LTR_CANDIDATE_IND
	   ,coalesce(dv.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID,-1) as NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID
      ,COALESCE(dv.PRODCAT_EBB_ID,0) AS PRODCAT_EBB_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.PRE_NRDP_XAP_EXIT_ID,-1) as PRE_NRDP_XAP_EXIT_ID
	  ,COALESCE(dv.MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID,-1) as MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID

	  ,-1 AS AGENT_TRAINING_ID
	  ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
	  ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
	  , COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID
      
	  --DMRCXSO-6426
	,CASE WHEN Media_Type = 'Audio' and behaviors_effective_denom > 0 THEN 1 ELSE null END as Call_Count
	,CASE WHEN (Media_Type = 'Written' or Media_Type = 'Chat') and behaviors_effective_denom > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END as Chat_Count
	,CASE WHEN ml_band_discover_needs = 10 and Media_Type = 'Audio' then 1 ELSE 0 END as DN_EFF_NUM_Call
	,CASE WHEN ml_band_listen_actively = 10 and Media_Type = 'Audio' then 1 ELSE 0 END as EA_EFF_NUM_Call
	,CASE WHEN ml_band_make_effortless = 10 and Media_Type = 'Audio' then 1 ELSE 0 END as MIE_EFF_NUM_Call

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[FACT_MDM_ORDERS_CANCELLED_V]

      ,C.[CALENDAR_DATE]
      ,CAST(Convert(CHAR(8),C.[CALENDAR_DATE],112) AS INT) AS [DATEKEY]
      ,C.[METRIC_SOURCE]
      --,C.[METRIC_SOURCE_KEY]
      ,C.CUBE_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY  % 100 AS CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY
      , COALESCE(EBB.CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY,0) AS CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY -- Added by SS ON 7/19/21

,CAST(-1 AS INTEGER) CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_DEMO_KEY -- Added by SS ON 7/19/21 --
,CAST(-1 AS INTEGER) MOVE_INCOME_CONSTRAINED_ID
      ,c.[PERNR_NUM]
    --  ,c.[NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID]
      ,[NRDP_CALL_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[BASE_RGU_PROFILE_ID]
      ,-1 as [TRANSFER_ORIGIN_AGENT_ID]
      ,-1 as [TRANSFER_ORIGIN_IACT_ID]
      ,[TENURE_ID]
      ,-1 AS NBX_M2M_ID
      ,10000 AS SENTIMENT_QA_ID
      ,-1 AS AGENT_TRAINING_ID
	  ,5000 AS CALL_DRIVER_QUERY_ID
      ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
      ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
      , COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID
,-1 as NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID
	  ,[SERVICE_ORDER_STATUS_CD]
,[BEG_SUB_CNT] as [CANCELLED_BEG_SUB_CNT]
,[END_SUB_CNT] as [CANCELLED_END_SUB_CNT]
,[BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT] as [CANCELLED_BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT]
,[END_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT] as [CANCELLED_END_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT]
,[BEG_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT] as [CANCELLED_BEG_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT]
,[END_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT] as [CANCELLED_END_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT]
,[BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT] as [CANCELLED_BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT]
,[END_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT] as [CANCELLED_END_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT]

, CASE WHEN COALESCE([END_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [CANCELLED_DROP_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT]

, CASE WHEN COALESCE([END_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [CANCELLED_DROP_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT]

, CASE WHEN COALESCE([END_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [CANCELLED_DROP_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT]

on C.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM

      ,[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[BASE_RGU_PROFILE_ID]

      ,-1 as [TRANSFER_ORIGIN_IACT_ID]
      ,[TENURE_ID]

,[BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT] as [PENDING_BEG_SUB_XTV_RGU_CNT]

, CASE WHEN COALESCE([END_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [PENDING_DROP_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT]

, CASE WHEN COALESCE([BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [END_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [PENDING_ADD_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT]
, CASE WHEN COALESCE([END_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [BEG_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [PENDING_DROP_SUB_XV_RGU_CNT]

, CASE WHEN COALESCE([END_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT],0) = 0 THEN [BEG_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT] ELSE 0 END AS [PENDING_DROP_SUB_XH_RGU_CNT]

	  ,CASE WHEN BEG_SUB_CNT = 0 AND  END_SUB_CNT>BEG_SUB_CNT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as  PENDING_NEW_CUST_CONNECTS

,COALESCE(EBB.PRODCAT_EBB_ID,0) AS PRODCAT_EBB_ID

 JOIN DIM_DATE D
 ON D.CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN C.RECORD_START_DT AND C.CALENDAR_DATE join 
  DIM_CURRENT_TODATE D1 
  ON D.CALENDAR_DATE = D1.CALENDAR_DATE left join 
[DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt
on C.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM
AND C.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT

--DIM_CUSTOMER_CUST_MAP_LKP_V CM 
--ON C.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY  = CM.BASE_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY
--AND coalesce(C.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID,-1)  = CM.NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID
left join FACT_EBB_BULK_REF EBB with (nolock)
    on c.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT] = EBB.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
  and c.[METRIC_SOURCE] = EBB.[METRIC_SOURCE]

  WHERE c.PERNR_NUM > 0 AND SERVICE_ORDER_STATUS_CD='PENDING'

CREATE view [dbo].[FACT_MDM_RUN_RATE_V]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT DATEDIFF(DAY, FISCAL_PERIOD_BEGIN_DATE,FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE) +1 AS NO_OF_DAYS, 
CASE WHEN FISCAL_PERIOD IN (SELECT MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) FROM DIM_DATE_CUSTOM_PERIODS) THEN DATEDIFF(DAY,FISCAL_PERIOD_BEGIN_DATE,GETDATE()) -1 
       ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, FISCAL_PERIOD_BEGIN_DATE,FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE)+1 END AS COUNT,
1 as DAILY_COUNT,
FISCAL_PERIOD,

from DIM_DATE

      ,[INTERACTION_HANDLED_COUNT]

      ,NULLIF([QUEUE_TIME],0) AS QUEUE_TIME
      ,NULLIF([RING_TIME],0) AS RING_TIME
      ,NULLIF([HANDLED_SERVICE_LVL],0) AS HANDLED_SERVICE_LVL
      ,NULLIF([VIRTUAL_HOLD],0) AS VIRTUAL_HOLD

      ,CAST(-1 AS BIGINT) AS [PRODCAT_EBB_ID]
      ,NULLIF([BEG_SUB_CNT],0) AS BEG_SUB_CNT

      ,NULLIF([BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT],0) AS BEG_SUB_XI_RGU_CNT

	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '10-20'THEN 4
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '20-30'THEN 5
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '30+'THEN 6
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '0' THEN 7
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '0-5'THEN 8
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '5-10'THEN 9
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '10-20'THEN 10
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '20-30'THEN 11
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP = '30+' THEN 12
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '0' THEN 13
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '0-5'THEN 14
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '5-10'THEN 15
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '10-20'THEN 16
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '20-30'THEN 17
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP = '30+' THEN 18
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP IS NULL THEN 19
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'PROMO-NO-ROLL' AND PR_REV_STEP IS NULL THEN 20
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS = 'EDP' AND PR_REV_STEP IS NULL THEN 21
	 WHEN PROMO_STATUS IS NULL AND PR_REV_STEP IS NULL THEN -1
	 ELSE -1 END AS PROMOROLLKEY

,COALESCE(DR.DISCONNECT_REASON_INDICATOR,-1) AS DISCONNECT_REASON_INDICATOR

      ,[XM_SALES_CONTRIBUTION_R2R_CNT]

--(CASE WHEN f.XM_LINES>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PERNR_NUM_2_XM_LINES,

--(CASE WHEN f.TOTAL_LINES>=10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PERNR_NUM_10_TOTAL_LINES,

dt.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT,
dt.DATEKEY
,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
      ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID

(
select COALESCE(XM.[CALENDAR_DATE],NOWM.[CALENDAR_DATE]) as [CALENDAR_DATE],
COALESCE(XM.[PERNR_NUM],NOWM.[PERNR_NUM]) as [PERNR_NUM],
COALESCE(XM.XM_LINES,0)+COALESCE(NOWM.ADD_NOW_XM_LINE_CNT,0) as TOTAL_LINES,
COALESCE(XM.XM_LINES,0) as XM_LINES

(

full outer join

on XM.[PERNR_NUM]=NOWM.[PERNR_NUM]
and xm.[CALENDAR_DATE]=NOWM.[CALENDAR_DATE]
)a
where TOTAL_LINES>0) f

(

      ,DATEKEY

      ,[AGENT_TRAINING_ID]
      ,[XM_LINE_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE_ID]

 UNPIVOT  
   (XSR_COUNT FOR XSR_COMPONENT  IN

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[FACT_MDM_XSR_V]
AS
SELECT CAST(1 AS INT) AS SERIES_ID,  F.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]
       ,COALESCE(D.[FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT],F.[FISCAL_PERIOD_INT]) AS FISCAL_PERIOD_TODATE_INT
      ,F.[CALENDAR_DATE]
      ,F.DATEKEY
      ,[METRIC_SOURCE]
      --,[METRIC_SOURCE_KEY]
      --,[NRDP_XM_ADD_FACT_ID]
    --  ,[ACTIVATION_NUMBER]
    --  ,[DATEKEY]
      ,[ORDER_CREATE_DATE]
      ,[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY] % 100 AS CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_KEY
      ,[CUSTOMER_EBB_BULK_KEY]
      ,[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_DEMO_KEY]
   --   ,[CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID]
      ,F.[PERNR_NUM]
   --   ,cast(CAST(F.[PERNR_NUM] as varchar(8)) + '.'+right(CAST(F.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT AS varchar(6)),4) as decimal(12,4) )  [NRDP_AGENT_FISCAL_PERIOD_ID]
	  ,COALESCE(agt.[AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID],-1) AS AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_ID 
      ,COALESCE(agt.SK_PERSON_HIER_ID,-1) AS PERSON_HIER_ID
      , COALESCE(agt.AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID,-1) AS AGENT_TENURE_HIER_ID

      ,[NRDP_CALL_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[NRDP_CLV_ATTRIBUTE_ID]
      ,[TRANSFER_ORIGIN_AGENT_ID]
      ,[TRANSFER_ORIGIN_IACT_ID]
      ,[TENURE_ID]
      ,[BASE_RGU_PROFILE_ID]
      ,[NBX_M2M_ID]
      ,[SENTIMENT_QA_ID]
      ,[NRDP_CUST_MAP_ID]
	        ,-1 AS [AGENT_TRAINING_ID]

      ,[PRODCAT_EBB_ID]
      ,[CALL_DRIVER_GROUP1_ID]
      ,[CALL_DRIVER_GROUP2_ID]
      ,[CALL_DRIVER_GROUP3_ID]
      ,[SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP1_ID]
      ,[SPEECH_QUERY_GROUP2_ID]
      ,COALESCE([XM_LINE_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE_ID],-1) AS XM_LINE_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE_ID  --ADDED BY SS ON 11/5/2021
      ,[ADD_FLEX_CONTRIBUTION_CNT]
      ,[ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT]
      ,[ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT]
      ,[ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT]
      ,[ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT]
      ,[ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT]
      ,[XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT]
      ,[XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_PT_CNT]
      ,[XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CHATPT_CNT]
      ,[XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_R2R_CNT]
	  ,CASE WHEN [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT] > 0 THEN 1 
		WHEN [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT] >0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT
      ,CASE WHEN [ADD_FLEX_CONTRIBUTION_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS ADD_FLEX_CONTRIBUTION_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS ADD_XSR_XFI_COMPLETE_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS ADD_XSR_XI_SPEED_TIER_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS ADD_XSR_XFI_GATEWAY_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS ADD_XSR_XTV_PREFER_TIER_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_PT_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_PT_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CHATPT_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CHATPT_PERNR
      ,CASE WHEN [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_R2R_CNT] > 0 AND F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END AS XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_R2R_PERNR
	  ,CASE WHEN F.PERNR_NUM > 0 THEN 
		  CASE WHEN [XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_REFERRAL_CNT] > 0 THEN  F.PERNR_NUM
		       WHEN [ADD_XSR_XM_LINE_SOLD_CNT] >0 THEN F.PERNR_NUM ELSE NULL END 
	   ELSE NULL END AS TOTAL_XM_LINE_CONTRIBUTION_CNT_PERNR
  FROM [NRDP_DM].[dbo].[FACT_XSR_ALL] F left join 
  DIM_CURRENT_TODATE D 
  ON F.CALENDAR_DATE = D.CALENDAR_DATE left join [DIM_TABULAR_AGENT_SKILL_LOCATION_LKP] agt with (nolock)
     on f.PERNR_NUM = AGT.PERNR_NUM  AND f.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT = AGT.FISCAL_PERIOD_INT
